title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether the Work Unit of a Missing Person May Apply to the People's Court for Declaration of the Missing Person's Death

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Reply on Whether the Work Unit of a Missing Person May Apply to the People's Court for Declaration of the Missing Person's Death
(1985) Min Ta Zi No. 28
Higher People's Court of Hubei Province:
We have received your Request Report E Fa (1985) Min Xing Zi No. 14, titled "On Whether the Work Unit of a Missing Person May Apply to the People's Court for Declaration of the Missing Person's Death."
After our study and consideration, it is held that the interested parties referred to in Article 133 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China (for Trial Implementation) must be persons who have a certain personal relationship or civil rights and obligations with the person for whom declaration of death is sought. The Standing Committee of the People's Congress of Xuan'en County, for the purpose of resolving issues such as staff reduction and supplementation and suspending the salary of the missing person Nie ××, shall not be suitable as an interested party to apply to the People's Court for declaration of the missing person's death. The matter shall be handled in accordance with the Organic Law of the Local People's Congresses and Local People's Governments of the People's Republic of China and the relevant provisions of China's labor system.
This is our reply.
February 18, 1986
